provisions.summary: Blanks out the 7.25% rate in the section 235-51(f) alternative tax on net capital gain for individuals, estates and trusts; the replacement rate is left blank.
provisions.quote: A tax of [7.25]   per cent of the amount of taxable income in excess of the amount determined under paragraph (1).

provisions.summary: Blanks out the 4% rate in the section 235-71.5 alternative tax on corporate net capital gain (the portion after the 1987 transition amount); the replacement rate is left blank. The spec cannot model corporate income tax.
provisions.quote: (B) [4]   per cent of the excess (if any) of:

notes: The bill's capital gains rate amounts are blank in the text (the 7.25 in 235-51(f) and the 4 in 235-71.5 are repealed and nothing replaces them), so no rate can be set and capital_gains_rate is left out of the spec. The corporate provision is outside the model regardless. Section 4's effective date of July 1, 2050 looks like a placeholder (a defective-effective-date drafting convention), and the bill says it applies to taxable years beginning after December 31, 2024; neither affects the modeling since no figure is given. Section 3 is boilerplate and not listed.
